body:
REWORK #2658 (TASK-1729), round 1 of 2. Advisor clarification of my own signoff: 'dirty' means uncommitted/untracked changes under objects/ ONLY (the tree the corpus reads); runtime dirs (timings/, mailbox/, coordination/, anything outside objects/) never count.
REQUIRED: (1) regen.rs dirty() (~150-156; git status at ~256/260): scope to '-- objects/'; add a test where an untracked file outside objects/ is NOT dirty and one inside objects/ IS. (2) Smoke run against the real store (~5k objects): run 'aida regen corpus' from your worktree build into an empty scratch dir, paste row_count + content_sha256 in the PR body, run twice and confirm byte-identical.
OPTIONAL (do if cheap): move the trace:TASK-1729 comment from above 'mod import_plan_cmd' (lib.rs:349) to 'mod regen'; add a legacy/no-.git store refusal test.
Push to the same branch, keep the PR open, mail the advisor the new head. Then continue to TASK-1730 (stack on #2658 if it is not merged).
subject: REWORK #2658 (TASK-1729) round 1
